---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or feature enhancement for Corvus
title: '[FEATURE] <Feature Name>'
labels: 'enhancement'
assignees: ''

---

## 💡 Feature Proposal
A clear and concise description of what feature, syntax improvement, compiler optimization, or standard library module you would like to see.

## 🎯 Motivation & Use Case
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Why would this feature benefit Corvus developers?

## 📝 Example Corvus Syntax / Usage
Show what the proposed Corvus code syntax or API would look like:

```corvus
// Proposed Corvus syntax
set int score = 100
// ...
```

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution / Implementation Ideas
Any ideas on whether this should be part of the AST Parser, Bytecode VM instruction set, Standard Library, or Native C99 compiler backend?

## 🔍 Additional Context / Alternatives
Any alternative solutions, features in other languages (e.g. Python, Rust, C), or related references.
